title: Prowe
headline: Legal software that runs on your own server.
intro: Prowe is a platform of modules for law firms and legal departments: documents, matters, questionnaires and contracts. The modules share one core — accounts, permissions and the audit log.

goals.title: Your data stays with you
goals.text: Prowe is installed on the firm's own server. Client files never go to someone else's cloud.

goals.title: History you can prove
goals.text: The audit log is append-only: the application has no permission to change it. Documents are versioned in git.

goals.title: One platform
goals.text: One account, one admin pane and shared permissions across every module.

goals.title: Open foundations
goals.text: Built only on permissively licensed open-source components. No vendor lock-in.

goals.title: Polish and English
goals.text: Interface and content in both languages from day one.

modules.name: Atrium
modules.summary: The front door: launcher, module catalog and administration.
modules.body:
Atrium shows the modules you have access to and lets you request the rest. Administrators run the whole platform from it.

- A launcher with your apps and a module switcher
- A module catalog with access requests
- Access for people and organizational units, including the units below them
- Accounts, permissions, the organization tree and the audit log in one pane

modules.name: Galena
modules.summary: A cloud drive with the full change history in git.
modules.body:
Galena looks like an ordinary drive: workspaces, folders, drag-and-drop, sharing. Underneath, every file lives in a git repository.

- Every change has an author and a date; file history and a version graph
- Drafts are reviewed before they are published
- PDF and image preview
- Optional AES-256-GCM encryption of files and folders

modules.name: Sygna
modules.summary: Practice management: clients, matters, deadlines and time.
modules.body:
Sygna runs a firm from first contact to the final invoice.

- Clients, matters and the parties to them
- Conflict-of-interest check when a matter is opened
- Procedural deadlines and time recording
- Information barriers: a walled matter disappears for everyone outside its team, administrators included

modules.name: Counsel Scorecard
modules.summary: Scored questionnaires with a full answer history.
modules.body:
Counsel Scorecard builds questionnaires and keeps the answers together with their change history.

- Questions, answer options and weighted sets
- Scores calculated automatically
- Every correction to an answer stays in the history
- Full-text search, limited by permissions

modules.name: Compass
modules.body:
Compass is a contract management system for legal departments and firms working across several jurisdictions.

- A contract repository with dates and renewals
- Clause variants for different jurisdictions
- AI assistance when drafting clauses

stack.label: Database
stack.value: PostgreSQL; a separate schema and roles for each module

stack.label: Deployment
stack.value: Docker Compose and Caddy on a single server
